reply_line: Questions? Simply reply to this email and we will help you.

placed.subject: We have received your order {id}
placed.message: Thank you for shopping with ORVISH. We have received your order and will email you as soon as it is on its way.

confirmed.subject: Your order {id} is confirmed
confirmed.message: Good news. Your order is confirmed and we are getting it ready.

packed.subject: Your order {id} is packed
packed.message: Your order is packed and will be handed to the courier soon.

shipped.subject: Your order {id} has been shipped
shipped.message: Your order has been shipped and is on its way to you.

out_for_delivery.subject: Your order {id} is out for delivery
out_for_delivery.message: Your order is out for delivery today. Please keep your phone nearby so the courier can reach you.

delivered.subject: Your order {id} has been delivered
delivered.message: Your order has been delivered. We hope you love it. If anything is not right, simply reply to this email.

cancelled.subject: Your order {id} has been cancelled
cancelled.message: Your order has been cancelled. If this is a mistake or you have a question, simply reply to this email.

return_requested.subject: We received your return request for order {id}
return_requested.message: We have received your return request. Our team will review it and email you the next steps shortly.

return_approved.subject: Your return for order {id} is approved
return_approved.message: Your return is approved. We will contact you to arrange the pickup. Please keep the product and its packaging ready.

returned.subject: We received your returned order {id}
returned.message: Your returned product has reached us. Your refund will be processed shortly.

refunded.subject: Your refund for order {id} has been processed
refunded.message: Your refund has been processed. Depending on your bank, it can take 5 to 7 working days to show in your account.
